title: A First-Step Bias Restores Lost Diversity in Diffusion Model Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distribution-matching distillation enables high-quality image generation in only a few denoising steps. However, distilled student models often map different initial noise samples to similar outputs under the same prompt. To locate where diversity is lost, we compare the teacher and student along the sampling trajectory. The largest measured reduction in the response to different initial noises occurs during the first, high-noise step. When we replace the first step with the teacher's corresponding trajectory and leave the final three student steps unchanged, most of the output diversity returns. This suggests that the first step is a key point for restoring diversity. Motivated by this finding, we introduce \emph{ReSeed}, a post-distillation method that adds a seed-response bias adapter only to the first student step and aligns its velocity with the teacher's first-interval secant velocity. All student weights and later denoising step

translated_title: 首步偏置恢复扩散模型蒸馏中丢失的多样性
translated_abstract: 分布匹配蒸馏使得仅需少量去噪步骤即可实现高质量的图像生成。然而，蒸馏后的学生模型在相同提示词下，往往将不同的初始噪声样本映射到相似的输出。为了定位多样性丢失的位置，我们沿采样轨迹对教师模型和学生模型进行了比较。测量发现，对不同初始噪声响应的最大降幅出现在第一步（即高噪声步骤）。当我们用教师模型对应的轨迹替换第一步，而保持学生模型最后三个步骤不变时，大部分输出多样性得以恢复。这表明第一步是恢复多样性的关键点。受此发现启发，我们提出了ReSeed——一种蒸馏后处理方法，它仅在学生模型的第一步添加一个种子响应偏置适配器，并使其速度与教师模型第一区间的割线速度对齐。所有学生模型权重和后续去噪步骤（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现扩散模型蒸馏导致的多样性丢失主要发生在第一步高噪声去噪阶段，据此提出ReSeed蒸馏后处理方法，通过仅在学生模型第一步添加种子响应偏置适配器并与教师模型割线速度对齐，有效恢复了蒸馏模型的输出多样性。
